match_invoice_with_bl::fallback_keys_sup.correction_letter:
Dear Carrier / Freight Forwarder,

RE: Correction Request for Draft B/L No: DRAFT-BL (Booking Ref: BKG-REF)
Import File Reference: ACID N/A

Following our formal cross-document reconciliation against the Final Commercial Invoice, please amend the following discrepancies on the final Bill of Lading:

1. Notify Party Details (الطرف المخطر (Notify Party)):
   - B/L Current Value: Not found in the B/L
   - Commercial Invoice Required Value: Archi Brands Trading
   - Reason: Notify party differs between the invoice and the B/L

2. Container Number(s) & Type (أرقام الحاويات ونوع الشحنة (Containers FCL/LCL)):
   - B/L Current Value: Not found in the B/L
   - Commercial Invoice Required Value: Not stated in the invoice
   - Reason: Container numbers in the invoice do not match the B/L.

Please issue the revised Draft B/L promptly to avoid customs clearance delays on the Egyptian Nafeza system.

Best Regards,
Import Operations & Customs Clearance Department
Sorour Logistics ERP System
